Road conditions

  • 800-381-8477-Road conditions
  • http://mdotwas1.mdot.state.mi.us/public/LaneClosure/ (Construction/Lane closures)
  • http://www.michigan.gov/mdot/0,1607,7-151-9622_11033_32060-98220--,00.html (Truckers map)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide,
  • Over 13'6" high,
  • Trailer over 50' long,
  • Over 80,000 lbs. On 5 axles

Special Information Needed

  • Load description, object wt, from-to, route, object width, height, length, vehicle width, trailer length, overall width, height, length, rear overhang

Times Of Movement

  • ½ hour before sunrise to ½ hour after sunset; no weekend travel
  • Travel prohibited on the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day . Permit office closed on above holidays plus Martin Luther King Day, Lincoln’s Birthday, Veteran’s Day, the day after Thanksgiving Day and the day after Christmas.
  • Movement not allowed from 7-9am & from 3-6pm in the following counties: Genesee, Ingham, Jackson, Kalamazoo, Kent, Muskegon, Macomb, Oakland, Saginaw, Wayne & Westenau

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • http://www.michigan.gov/documents/MDOT_MoveOS_OW_T2_92127_7.pdf
  • Over 12' to 14' wide-1
  • Over 14' wide-2 (front & rear)
  • 90' to 100' long-1 rear
  • Over 100'- 2 (front & rear)
  • Over 14'5" high with high pole-1 front
  • Over 15' high with high pole-2 (front & rear)
  • Overhang over 15'-1 rear

Mobile Homes/Modular Loads:

  • 12' to 14' wide-1 rear

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: Passenger car or pickup truck
  • Signs: “OVERSIZE LOAD” sign 5’ x 12” w/ black letters (8” high) on yellow background on roof of vehicle
  • Lights: at least one flashing/rotating amber light on top of vehicle visible for 500’
  • Flags: No stipulations
  • Additional equipment: A height pole is required set at a height to assure clearance of the load if height of load exceeds 14’ 6”

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • None stipulated
